caseName: 完整用户故事规格书生成
prompt: 请基于项目的 real.md、cog.md 和 pr.spec.md，将所有三个 MAS（MAS-1、MAS-2、MAS-3）拆解为完整的用户故事规格书（userstory.spec.md）。产品处于 MVP 阶段。请生成完整文档，包括复杂故事概览、所有最小故事、故事地图和故事类型分布表。
expectedBehavior: 应生成完整的 userstory.spec.md，包含复杂故事概览表、每个 CS 下的 MS 详情、按迭代组织的故事地图、以及类型分布统计表。

expectations.description: Output contains all four required top-level sections: '复杂故事概览' (with a table), at least one CS section for each of the three MAS, '故事地图', and '故事类型分布'
Every MS includes a 故事评判 block with type-specific field labels: 光明→起点/转折/终点, 黑暗→正常态/异变/恢复, 灰色→循环模式/优化点/习惯形成; no MS is missing its judgment block and no type uses the wrong labels
Aggregate type distribution follows MVP golden ratio ~70/20/10 (光明 ≥60%, 灰色 ≤20%)
Constraint references use upstream citations rather than copying text inline
故事地图 uses hierarchical tree structure organized by iteration with CS branches and MS leaves labeled with type
Each MS's 验收标准 contains at least 2 testable criteria specific to ALPDesigner domain
